document.title: Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945 (Part XVI, XVII & Schedule T)

sections.section_title: Application for License to Manufacture for Sale of Ayurvedic (including Siddha) or Unani Drugs
sections.content: Rule 153 mandates that applications for a license to manufacture for sale any Ayurvedic, Siddha, or Unani drug shall be made in Form 25D to the State Licensing Authority, accompanied by proof of compliance with Schedule T Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).

sections.section_title: Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) for Ayurvedic, Siddha and Unani Medicines
sections.content: Schedule T prescribes factory premises requirements, hygienic conditions, machinery equipment, quality control laboratory standards, and raw material batch testing protocols required for manufacturing licensed ASU drugs.

sections.section_title: Labeling, Packing and Limit of Alcohol in Ayurvedic (including Siddha) or Unani Drugs
sections.content: Rule 161 requires clear display of true list of all active ingredients, botanical names, manufacturing license number, batch number, expiry date, and warning statements on outer containers of ASU medicines.
